investigation: Static source inspection and retained validation output; no new program execution.
finding: Ceiling-sized column partitions are not clamped to empty for ranks whose start is beyond n. With n=513 and 128 ranks, cols_per_proc is 5; ranks 103 through 127 have my_col_start>n, my_col_end=n and unsigned my_num_cols underflow. Constructing local_A requests a length beyond vector::max_size. The root packing repeats the same invalid subtraction.
observed_failure: Multiple MPI ranks throw std::length_error: cannot create std::vector larger than max_size(), aborting the job with exit 134 after 13.49 seconds.
interpretation: Deterministic empty-partition arithmetic failure, not memory-pressure exhaustion or a concurrent-scheduling timeout. Retain failure without retry.
